run_validate_yaml: run the validate_yaml script to check that all GitHub Actions jobs are in the blocking jobs list
run_validate_continuous_condition: run the validate_yaml script to verify all continuous-prefix jobs check the continuous-run condition on every step

summarize_validate_yaml: summarize the validate_yaml script which checks blocking job membership and continuous-run conditions in GitHub Actions workflows
